Land Acquisition Notices
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER PROVISO (A) TO SECTION 38
Order No. 47 of 2025

My Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2023/HW/82. Acq. ofﬁ cer Ref. No.: KEG/RBK/LLA/AQURE/D58/149. By virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Ofﬁ cer or any other ofﬁ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph I of the schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph II of that Schedule. K. D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,20th May, 2025.
SCHEDULE
I. Acquiring Ofﬁ cer.– Divisional Secretary, Rambukkana.

II. Description of the land.– The allotment of land described in below name and depicted in the Surveyor General’s Advance Tracing No. KE/RMB/2023/427 dated 27.09.2024 situated at Naththambura Village in No. 03 Naththambura Grama Niladhari Division, in Rambukkana Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kegalle District, Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Maraagahamulahena Denata Waththa alias Maragahamulahena alias Appuwage Waththa – Extent: 0.0160 Hectare North: Lot No. 203, 30 and 24 of FVP 129; East: Lot No. 24, 209 and 208 of FVP 129; South: Lot No. 208 and 204 of FVP 129; West: Lot No. 204 and 203 of FVP 129.
